criteria.label: Dependency installation
criteria.note: Exact versions installed, lockfile retained. A clean `npm ci --offline` from the populated cache installed 273 packages. npm skipped the optional fsevents install script.

criteria.label: Strict type check
criteria.note: `npm run check` reported zero errors, warnings or hints.

criteria.label: Production build
criteria.note: `npm run build` generated five HTML pages and a sitemap in `dist/`.

criteria.label: Navigation
criteria.note: Followed all four header links and returned home by the wordmark at both widths. Checked every page link, its HTTP response and each fragment target.

criteria.label: Console and resources
criteria.note: No browser console errors, uncaught exceptions, failed requests or HTTP errors during the two route sweeps.

criteria.label: Desktop layout
criteria.note: Inspected the 1440 × 1000 homepage. All five pages fit the viewport without horizontal scrolling.

criteria.label: Mobile layout
criteria.note: Inspected the 390 × 844 homepage in mobile Chrome emulation. Header links stayed usable and each page fit the viewport.

criteria.label: Accessibility spot checks
criteria.note: First Tab exposed the skip link and Enter focused main. One h1 per route. Sample contrast ratios were 13.6:1 for body text, 6.1:1 for muted text on paper and 11.9:1 for lime on charcoal.

criteria.label: Financial integrity
criteria.note: Both period records contain null monetary fields. Ledger has 17 awaiting-verification metric cells across the two periods; November coverage is outside target. In-memory fixtures checked null vs zero, held funds, partial payout, expense, refund and loss.

criteria.label: Product availability
criteria.note: Empty catalogue, no purchase or preview links. Candidate carries Proposed status. The original note illustration identifies US$20 as the target. Journal and proposal carry the US$13 test price.

criteria.label: Public content and privacy
criteria.note: Reviewed public data, documents and media. Filename and text-pattern checks on project files and generated output found no credential, private-key, bank-identifier or local-home-path matches. No customer records or private financial exports supplied.

criteria.label: Static delivery and metadata
criteria.note: HTML works on plain file hosting. No client scripts, external resource requests or cookies observed. All pages include description, canonical, Open Graph and favicon references. Sitemap has the five canonical routes. Original 1200 × 630 social image inspected locally.

criteria.label: Live hosting, live social previews, checkout and payouts
criteria.note: Owner publication and account authorization pending.

criteria.label: Physical devices, other browsers and full assistive-technology audit
criteria.note: Scope of browser checks was desktop Chrome and a 390px emulated viewport.

criteria.label: Buyer demand and time saved
criteria.note: Candidate is a proposal. SURV-002 defines the sample comparison.
